creator.niche: Kỹ năng AI (edit video, làm nội dung, làm việc hiệu quả) cho người Việt mới bắt đầu, chỉ từng bước bằng tiếng Việt

notes: Full camera all along (layout seam 0): no paper, no split after the hook. Every graphic sits ON the video.

HOOK (first ~7 s, copy of @zoe_genai): the camera zoomed, heavily blurred and darkened fills the frame. On it: a sparkle mark + 'AI' (white, bold) at y 400 above a TALL rounded card at the left (x 84 to 641, y 465 to 1455, radius 30) = the edited version, and a small 'Raw' card at the right (x 672 to 997, y 850 to 1425) with the white bold label 'Raw' above it. The tall card swaps its background about every 0.5 to 1 s (hard cut) with giant condensed words in front of or behind the speaker. Build it from assets/components/hook-omni.html (the header of the file lists every command: matteSpans for the person cut-out, three frame sets, capture, then prepare again; tau = short time). The speaker inside the tall card is cut out with the engine's person mask (frames/matte) on swapping backgrounds: deep red with giant words behind, a media-player window, yellow with a calendar icon, a REC viewfinder, split cream and yellow with 3D words in FRONT, a teal cutting mat with white arrows, a dark close-up with a yellow scribble.

After the hook: a hard cut to the full camera. No fade, no punch-in, no push. Face (hair to chin) 30 to 35 % of the frame height: choose cam.crop from the median MediaPipe face box (vision-web.mjs faces), never by eye (a tight crop on a speaker who leans in gave 48 %).

Captions: ALL CAPS, heavy condensed (original: bold italic), white with a black outline and soft shadow, about 55 px, 2 to 4 words a chunk, at y 1318 (68 % of the frame, just under the chin), never on the mouth.
CTA: the keyword (one per video, tied to the guide) in huge white caps at the top (y about 425), about 3x the caption size, with a 0.2 s color glitch when it lands. No emoji.

Sound: no music bed (nothing under the voice). At most two or three soft whooshes (zhhh) on the big background swaps of the hook, one light click on the hook to camera cut. No tap runs, no riser, no click on every cut.
The original body is a phone filming a laptop screen with a finger pointing. Use the creator's REAL screen recordings; never a pasted screenshot.
Never Archivo Black, Poppins, DM Sans or Instrument Serif for Vietnamese text: no diacritics. Use Archivo, Inter, Bricolage Grotesque, JetBrains Mono or Pangolin.

MOTION PACK (the content layer after the hook; full notes in STYLE.md, section 'Motion pack'): assets/components/fx2.html draws it from source/fx2-config.js (window.FX2), which gen_fx2.py writes from files/words.md + keywords.vi.json + an optional source/plan.json (python -I gen_fx2.py <project> [--spec]). Files: fx2.html, gen_fx2.py, keywords.vi.json, buddy.js (the original coral 'spark' mascot: wave cheer wow think idea run), icons2.js, plus edita-icons.js copied from styles/edita-visuals/assets/components; preview_server.py + preview.html show frames over the camera without rendering. Everything moves AROUND the person (slots TL TR SL SR, chest caption, collar ribbon; face keep-out x 310 to 770, y 430 to 1040 for cam.crop [59, 85, 1294, 2300]); captions change place, style and colour per phrase (captions.hide [[0, 999]]); sound extras stay modest (pop on mascot landings, bell on cheer and idea, slide on the panel and the first cards, tap on a flash).
